newsitem.title: GERMANY: Equity funds in Germany continue to advance - DBI.
newsitem.headline: Equity funds in Germany continue to advance - DBI.

text.p: Dresdner Bank's investment group DBI said on Wednesday that 70 percent of fund inflows in early part of 1997 went into equity funds, as German investor interest in share-backed funds hits record levels.

Also, equity-backed funds provided the greatest returns of the Dresdner's investment fund portfolio in 1996, said Rolf Passow, managing director of Dresdner Bank Investmentgruppe's funds unit Deutsche Investment Trust (DIT).
In the first six weeks of this year, the group saw net inflows of 1.9 billion marks ($1.1 billion), of which 70 percent went to equity funds and 30 percent to bond-backed funds.
Total fund inflows at DIT in 1996 increased to 6.2 billion marks from 2.5 billion marks the previous year.
Top performer among its equity funds was DIT's eastern and central European fund, DIT-Dresdner-Osteuropa fund, which grew 83.6 percent in 1996.

In second place came its Iberian fund, DIT-Fonds Iberia, which grew 48.2 percent in 1996 and in third place its fund based on British shares, DIT-Fonds Gross Britannien, which grew 45.6 percent last year.
DIT's equity funds based on the performance of German shares, DIT-Wachstums-Fonds, grew 33 percent, compared to growth on the overall DAX index over the year of 28.2 percent.

DIT said its bond-backed funds also registered strong growth, with its DIT-Lux Bondspezial growing 21.3 percent in 1996, up from 10.2 percent a year earlier, while its international bond-backed fund grew 16 percent over the year.
Passow said one of the stars of its portfolio had been its Multimedia fund, which had seen inflows of 730 million marks since its inception in mid-November 1996.

DIT and other banks set up multimedia funds after the Deutsche Telekom flotation in November to pick up excess funds from the massively oversubscribed sell-off and to invest them in multimedia and telecoms stocks.
"The total volume of funds under managment at DBI is around 110 billion marks and with this volume we have reached European dimensions," said Passow.
Passow said that private pension proivision would be one of the main areas of focus for DIT in the future.
"The private investor has to be informed quickly of the need for individual pension provision," said Passow.

Passow said that plans to impose tax on life insurance, a major vehicle for private pension provision in Germany, was counterproductive, and flew in the face of government assertions that private pension provision was a necessary.
